headline: Controversy in Spain after VOX proposal to tax remittances of the Moroccan community
summary: Spain's far-right party Vox included in its electoral programme a proposal to tax transfers, sparking controversy among the Moroccan community. The proposal targets remittances sent abroad.
why: Remittance taxes would affect cash flows from migrant workers to home countries and could change transfer costs for banks and money transfer firms.
